query:
SELECT empresaSlug, 
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat1_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat2_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat3_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat4_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat5_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat6_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat7_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat8_total,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as cat9_total
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI')
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
